claims.claim: The ICJ ruled Myanmar committed acts of genocide against the Rohingya and had never previously found a state responsible for genocide.
claims.episode_span: never previously found a state responsible for genocide
claims.source_title: Myanmar committed acts of genocide against Rohingya minority, world’s top court rules
claims.supporting_quote: The judgment from the international court of justice (ICJ) – which has never previously found a state responsible for genocide – ends a seven-year legal battle

claims.claim: ICJ president Yuji Iwasawa said evidence shows Myanmar forces killed some 10,000 Rohingya.
claims.episode_span: evidence shows Myanmar’s forces killed some 10,000 Rohingya
claims.source_title: UN top court convicts Myanmar of ‘genocidal intent’ against Rohingya
claims.supporting_quote: Evidence shows Myanmar forces killed some 10,000 Rohingya, ICJ President Yuji Iwasawa said during a three-hour readout of the verdict.

claims.claim: Iwasawa said the court was fully convinced Myanmar acted under the Genocide Convention with intent to destroy a substantial part of the Rohingya.
claims.episode_span: intent to destroy a substantial part of the Rohingya population in Myanmar
claims.source_title: Myanmar committed acts of genocide against Rohingya minority, world’s top court rules
claims.supporting_quote: “The court is fully convinced that Myanmar committed acts falling under … the genocide convention with an intent to destroy a substantial part of the Rohingya population in Myanmar,” the ICJ president, Yuji Iwasawa, said during a reading of the judgment.

claims.claim: More than 700,000 Rohingya fled to Bangladesh in the 2016-17 campaign, and fewer than 600,000 are estimated to remain in Myanmar.
claims.episode_span: forced more than 700,000 mostly Muslim Rohingya into Bangladesh
claims.source_title: Myanmar committed acts of genocide against Rohingya minority, world’s top court rules
claims.supporting_quote: A 2016-17 campaign by Myanmar’s military forced more than 700,000 mostly Muslim Rohingya to flee across the border into Bangladesh

claims.claim: Al Jazeera reported more than 730,000 Rohingya fled and more than 1.3 million remain displaced, including 1.2 million in Cox’s Bazar.
claims.episode_span: more than 1.3 million Rohingya remain displaced, including 1.2 million in camps in Cox’s Bazar
claims.source_title: UN top court convicts Myanmar of ‘genocidal intent’ against Rohingya
claims.supporting_quote: More than 1.3 million Rohingya remain displaced across South and Southeast Asia, including 1.2 million in sprawling refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar in Bangladesh, according to the United Nations.

claims.claim: The court said the only reasonable inference was genocidal intent and that Myanmar violated its obligation to prevent genocide.
claims.episode_span: Myanmar violated its obligation to prevent genocide
claims.source_title: UN top court convicts Myanmar of ‘genocidal intent’ against Rohingya
claims.supporting_quote: “Myanmar thus violated its obligation to prevent genocide,” it added.

claims.claim: Min Aung Hlaing has a pending ICC arrest warrant on allegations of crimes against humanity and was installed as civilian president in April after widely discredited elections.
claims.episode_span: pending International Criminal Court arrest warrant on allegations of crimes against humanity
claims.source_title: Myanmar committed acts of genocide against Rohingya minority, world’s top court rules
claims.supporting_quote: The country’s leader, Min Aung Hlaing, who headed the military during the 2016-2017 attacks, has a pending arrest warrant from the international criminal court (ICC), which prosecutes individuals and not states like the ICJ, on allegations of crimes against humanity.

claims.claim: Trump, Xi and Putin agreed there can be no winners in a nuclear war and it should never be unleashed, after about an hour and a half of talks.
claims.episode_span: a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought
claims.source_title: Trump, Xi and Putin sit down for a rare three-way meeting in China
claims.supporting_quote: Finally, the Russian government said the leaders had "reaffirmed that there can be no winners in a nuclear war, and that it should never be unleashed."

claims.claim: The Kremlin readout included UN reform, more oil and gas production, state immunities, and a warning that the ICC should not abuse its powers.
claims.episode_span: the International Criminal Court and similar bodies should not abuse their powers
claims.source_title: Trump, Xi and Putin sit down for a rare three-way meeting in China
claims.supporting_quote: They also committed to increasing gas and oil production "for the benefit of all countries," agreed on the "fundamental importance" of "the principle of state consent and respect for the immunities of state officials," and said the " International Criminal Court and other similar bodies should not abuse their powers."

claims.claim: Trump said they were making history; Putin cited shared interests including Ukraine; Xi did not refer to Ukraine directly.
claims.episode_span: We are really making history
claims.source_title: Trump, Xi, Putin conclude historic meeting on Ukraine war, nuclear arms
claims.supporting_quote: "We are really making history," Trump said at the beginning.

claims.claim: Xinhua cited Xi saying nuclear weapons should be prohibited and eliminated.
claims.episode_span: nuclear weapons should be prohibited and eliminated
claims.source_title: Trump, Xi, Putin conclude historic meeting on Ukraine war, nuclear arms
claims.supporting_quote: Separately, state agency Xinhua cited Xi as telling the other two leaders that nuclear weapons should be "prohibited" and "eliminated, with the ultimate goal of establishing a world free of nuclear weapons".

claims.supporting_quote: Gaza's Hamas-run government media office meanwhile said that an estimated 6,000 people had fled their homes and tents because of the operation, and that this amounted to the war crime of forced displacement.
